Rod of Metamagic, Thundering
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 191, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 296
Aura strong (no school) CL 17th
Slot none; Price 9,000 gp (lesser), 32,500 gp (normal), 73,000 gp (greater); Weight 5 lbs.
Description
The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that deafen affected creatures as though using the Thundering Spell feat (Advanced Player’s Guide).
Construction
Requirements Craft Rod, Thundering Spell; Cost 4,500 gp (lesser), 16,250 gp (normal), 36,500 gp (greater)
